integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] Dark fantasy cinematic martial-arts animation with painterly detail and dramatic moonlit blue lighting. Begin exactly from <Picture 1>. Preserve the same adult female swordswoman, facial identity, black hair, dark layered martial-arts costume, flowing red-orange fabric, sword, body proportions, and the same gigantic horned shadow creature. Preserve the moonlit ruined environment, cold blue palette, wet reflective ground, distant traditional architecture, drifting mist, and the established spatial relationship: the swordswoman remains in the foreground-left facing the enormous creature occupying the right side of the frame.

The swordswoman holds her low combat stance for only a brief instant as her clothing and loose fabric react naturally to the wind. She then drives forcefully forward toward the creature with a fast, grounded martial-arts step, keeping her center of gravity low and her sword under firm control. Her leading foot pushes through the wet ground, producing a small burst of water and debris while her trailing fabric stretches backward from the sudden acceleration.

Without stopping or changing direction, she converts the forward momentum into one continuous sword attack. Her torso rotates, shoulders and hips turn together, and both arms guide the sword through a broad, powerful sweeping slash. The motion must remain physically connected: forward step → body rotation → sword acceleration → full sweeping strike. Do not introduce additional spins, flips, jumps, unrelated attacks, or extra weapons.

As the sword reaches maximum speed, a concentrated blue-white energy trail forms directly along the blade path. The energy begins as a narrow luminous streak close to the sword rather than appearing independently. It rapidly expands outward as the slash continues, tracing one large curved crescent through the air. The glowing sword arc sweeps from the swordswoman across the center of the frame toward the gigantic creature, pushing mist, loose particles and surface spray outward along its path.

The creature remains visually consistent with <Picture 1>: enormous black-blue body, branching horn-like structures, rough spectral texture and glowing red facial markings. It reacts to the incoming strike by leaning and recoiling slightly backward while its upper body and surrounding dark vapor are displaced by the force of the energy wave. Do not transform the creature, change its anatomy, create additional monsters, or make it disappear.

During the final phase of the shot, progressively converge toward <Picture 2>. The swordswoman advances from the lower-left foreground into the more central-left position seen in <Picture 2>. Her torso extends into the attack, her sword reaches the exact sweeping orientation of the final frame, and her red-orange trailing fabric stretches backward with the motion. The blue-white sword energy grows into the same dominant luminous crescent shape visible in <Picture 2>, curving around the swordswoman and across the frame toward the creature. The creature, moon, architecture, ground plane and overall framing progressively match the final composition.

At the 5.00-second mark, land precisely on <Picture 2>: the swordswoman is captured at the peak of the decisive sweeping slash, positioned and oriented exactly as shown in the reference; the enormous blue-white crescent sword wave dominates the middle of the frame; the gigantic horned creature recoils behind it on the upper-right; the full moon remains visible in the upper-left background; and the dark blue ruined environment, water spray, mist, debris, lighting and composition match <Picture 2> as closely as possible.

Use one continuous shot with no cuts. The camera performs a restrained lateral tracking movement following the swordswoman from left toward center while maintaining the creature's massive scale in the background. The camera must not orbit around the characters, perform a dramatic zoom, suddenly change height, or reverse direction. Keep the movement smooth and cinematic so that the transformation from <Picture 1> to <Picture 2> is driven primarily by the swordswoman's attack rather than by camera motion.

Maintain stable character identity, stable facial structure, realistic and coherent limb anatomy, correct hand-to-sword contact, a rigid and clearly defined sword, consistent costume geometry, physically plausible foot placement, coherent body rotation, stable creature anatomy, and consistent environment geometry throughout the entire shot. Preserve the painterly dark-fantasy visual style of both reference images. Use natural directional motion blur only during the fastest sword movement and energy sweep while keeping the swordswoman's face, body silhouette, sword and creature clearly readable.

overall_soundscape:
A cold nighttime wind moves continuously through the ruined environment with faint low-frequency ambience from the gigantic creature. The swordswoman's rapid footwork produces sharp wet impacts and small water splashes, accompanied by fast cloth movement. Her sword produces a clean accelerating metallic whoosh that grows into a powerful sweeping air-cut sound as the blue-white energy arc expands, followed by one deep impact pulse and a brief restrained creature roar synchronized with the completed slash. Keep all sounds clean, spatially coherent and synchronized with the visible action, with no clipping, hiss or distortion.

subject_definitions:
<Video 1> is the source video being edited: a 5.2-second locked-off medium two-shot inside a warm rustic music room. Its camera framing, fixed camera position, timing, blocking, bench arrangement, and single-shot cut structure are retained exactly in the target video.
<Subject 1> is the woman placed into the center of <Video 1>, whose full appearance is defined by <Picture 1>: a young East Asian woman with fair skin, delicate natural features, dark hair tied back in a low ponytail with a few soft loose strands framing her face, wearing a sage-green cable-knit V-neck cropped button cardigan, a cream-colored multi-tiered ruffled lace tulle midi skirt, a thin silver necklace with a heart-shaped pendant, and beige pointed-toe bow-detail high heels. Her seated body position, head movement, hand gesture, and singing/lip action are transferred from the original woman in <Video 1>.
<Subject 2> is the young man seated to the woman's right in <Video 1>: short curly dark-brown hair, an olive-green button-up overshirt over a gray crew-neck T-shirt, blue jeans, hands clasped between his knees, turning his head to watch the woman and then smiling gently. He is kept completely unchanged.
<Subject 3> is the room environment in <Video 1>: warm wood-paneled lower walls, rows of simple light-wood benches, several natural-wood acoustic guitars (one on a stand by the window, two on wall-mounted stands behind), a large multi-paned wooden casement window on the left with lush green trees and a black iron balcony railing visible outside, and a black cast-iron radiator on the far left. It is kept completely unchanged.
<Audio 1> is the synchronized audio track of <Video 1>, containing the woman's vocal performance and the room's natural ambience, and is reused as the target video's complete final audio track.

summary:
[video editing + reference generation + audio reuse] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1> in which only the woman in the center of the frame is replaced by <Subject 1> from <Picture 1>. <Subject 2> and <Subject 3> remain pixel-faithful to <Video 1>; the original woman's seated singing action, palms-up hand gesture, and backward head tilt are transferred onto <Subject 1>; the locked-off camera, framing, and lighting are unchanged; and <Audio 1> is reused 1:1.

retention_analysis:
<Video 1> (camera framing, fixed camera position, timing, blocking, single-shot structure): fully_preserved - the static medium two-shot, bench placement, left-window daylight direction, and 5.2-second duration are retained exactly.
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): attribute_transfer - her face, low ponytail, sage-green cable-knit cardigan, cream tiered lace skirt, and heart pendant come from <Picture 1>, while her seated posture on the bench, palms-up hand gesture, backward head tilt, closed eyes, and singing/lip movement are transferred from the original woman in <Video 1>.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the curly-haired man, his olive overshirt, gray T-shirt, blue jeans, clasped hands, head turn toward the woman, and gentle smile are unchanged.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the wood-paneled walls, wooden benches, acoustic guitars, multi-paned window, outdoor greenery, black iron railing, and black radiator are unchanged.
<Audio 1>: fully_copy - the synchronized vocal performance and room ambience of <Video 1> are reused 1:1 as the target video's complete final audio track.

detailed_description:
The target video keeps the warm, naturalistic cinematic look of <Video 1>: soft golden daylight streaming from the left window, warm wood tones, gentle soft-edged shadows, and a natural shallow depth of field. The camera is a locked-off, static medium two-shot identical to <Video 1>, framing both seated figures from the mid-thigh up on the wooden bench, with no push-in, pan, or zoom.
[Shot 1] The scene opens on <Subject 3>, the rustic music room: wood-paneled lower walls, rows of light-wood benches, natural-wood acoustic guitars (one on a stand beside the window, two on wall mounts behind), a large multi-paned wooden casement window on the left through which lush green trees and a black iron balcony railing are visible, and a black radiator at the far left. Seated center-frame on the bench is <Subject 1>, the replacement woman whose appearance comes from <Picture 1>: young East Asian woman with fair skin and delicate features, dark hair in a low ponytail with soft loose strands framing her face, wearing the sage-green cable-knit V-neck cropped button cardigan and the cream multi-tiered ruffled lace tulle midi skirt that falls in soft layered folds over the bench, the thin silver heart-pendant necklace resting at her collarbone. Her seat position, distance from the man, and all body motion are inherited from the original woman in <Video 0>. At the start, her hands are folded together on her lap and her head is slightly bowed with her eyes lowered; she then unclasps her hands and opens them palms-up, resting loosely on her thighs in an expressive relaxed gesture, lifts her chin, tilts her head gently backward, closes her eyes, and opens her mouth in a sustained singing/vocalizing performance, her lips moving naturally in sync with the preserved audio. To her right (viewer's right), <Subject 2>, the curly-haired young man in the olive-green overshirt, gray T-shirt, and blue jeans, sits with his hands clasped between his knees, turns his head to watch <Subject 1>, and gradually breaks into a quiet, gentle smile. No camera movement occurs; framing, focus, and lighting remain exactly as in <Video 0> throughout the 5.2-second take, with only the center woman's identity, face, hair, and outfit swapped onto the reference character.

overall_soundscape:
The copied warm room tone and natural air ambience of the music room from <Audio 1> continue throughout the take; the woman's lead vocal performance, originally recorded in sync with her lip movement, is preserved 1:1 without being re-recorded or re-voiced.
